description: TileGuard demo datasets for FOSS4G 2026 presentation

datasets.title: Tokyo — Clean Tile
datasets.description: A well-formed 403 KB vector tile covering central Tokyo. All layers valid, no diagnostics expected. Use this to demonstrate the Inspector feature explorer and canvas interaction.
datasets.speakerNote: Open this tile first. Show the Feature Explorer on the left — layers, feature counts. Click a road feature to open the Feature Inspector panel on the right. Zoom in to see individual vertices.

datasets.title: Broken Geometry
datasets.description: Synthetic tile with a self-intersecting polygon. The diagnostics engine will flag tile/self-intersection with precise location and a suggested fix.
datasets.speakerNote: Switch to the Diagnostics tab. The Tile Health panel shows 1 error. Click the error row — the camera animates to the affected feature and the Rule Details panel on the right explains why this is invalid and how to fix it.

datasets.title: Missing Required Property
datasets.description: Synthetic tile where features are missing a required property. Demonstrates the tile/required-properties rule.
datasets.speakerNote: A tile with out-of-range coordinates. Shows the coordinate-range rule in action.

datasets.title: Comparison — Before & After
datasets.description: Two tiles representing a before/after deployment. Load both into the Compare tab to see which features changed, appeared, or disappeared.
datasets.speakerNote: Switch to the Compare tab. Load 'before.pbf' as tile A and 'after.pbf' as tile B. Click Run Comparison. The Difference Explorer shows added/removed/changed features layer by layer.

datasets.title: Regression Investigation
datasets.description: Two tiles that can be diffed to identify a regression. The Regression tab analyses the comparison output for high-confidence regressions with evidence.
datasets.speakerNote: After running a comparison, switch to the Regression tab. The engine identifies the highest-confidence regressions and ranks them. Click a candidate to see the Evidence Panel with geometry diffs.

datasets.title: Style Linting
datasets.description: A valid MapLibre style specification for analysis in the Style Explorer tab.
datasets.speakerNote: Open the Style Explorer tab and load this style.json. The linter validates all 9 style rules instantly — source references, zoom ranges, duplicate layer IDs, deprecated properties.
